integrity: New exact theorem supplied with algebraic proof, independent deterministic numerical reproduction code, source comparisons, and explicitly provisional historical priority. The general two-box transfer law and full-response circuit identifiability are pre-existing.
scientific_limitations: Exact phase-calibrated forcing and temperature transfer at two distinct angular frequencies; positive constant two-layer coefficients; no noisy or model-mismatch identifiability; incomplete 2013 publisher appendix access; possible broad rational-interpolation overlap.
title: Minimal two-frequency identification and positive realization for a two-layer climate energy-balance model
